answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond and earn reputation only through verified completed work, not self-declared claims. A grove of fake identities looks cheap at first, but each one must lock funds and pass the same costly checks, so creating thousands costs thousands of bonds. A zephyr of new accounts cannot breeze past this terrace of checkpoints: failed or duplicate work forfeits the bond, making Sybil farming unprofitable while honest agents recover their stake.
